analysis: Phase 4 introduces three major new service areas (IncrementalGraphDiffService, AstIndexService, EntityGraphService) and extends existing RagService.importGraphify(). Key files to modify: apps/api/src/rag/rag.service.ts, apps/api/src/rag/dto/ import-graphify.dto.ts. New files needed: incremental-graph-diff.service.ts, ast-index.service.ts, entity-graph.service.ts, impact-analysis.service.ts, canonical-state.service.ts, plus corresponding DTOs and Prisma schema additions. Dependencies: US-001 (base) → US-002 → US-004; US-001 + US-002 + US-003 → US-005; US-006 is independent. Schema additions (GraphNode, GraphLink, EntityNode, EntityLink, Symbol) follow SQLite-compatible JSON-string pattern. Parser choice: ts-morph for TypeScript symbol extraction. Symbol ID convention: {repoId}:{filePath}::{SymbolName}. Impact score formula has denominator guards to prevent division by zero.

userStories.title: Incremental Graph Diff — Replace Full Re-Import
acceptanceCriteria: IncrementalGraphDiffService.diffAndApply() computes a diff and applies only the delta
Stored graph is loaded from GraphNode + GraphLink Prisma tables, not from LanceDB
When newNodes has 100 nodes and stored has 90, diffAndApply() returns added=10, removed=0
When a stored node is absent from newNodes, it is deleted from both GraphNode table and LanceDB (by graphify nodeId / RAG sourceId)
When a node exists in both with unchanged content, it is skipped (no re-index)
diffAndApply() is called by the existing importGraphify endpoint and replaces the current deleteAllBySourceType logic
DiffResult.indexed reflects only the number of nodes actually written to LanceDB (not the total node count)
A diff-and-apply of 500 unchanged nodes + 10 added + 5 removed completes in under 2 seconds
DiffResult includes durationMs for performance monitoring
Only actors with role admin, developer, or agent can call importGraphify (enforced at controller layer)
suggestedCriteria: When newNodes is empty and stored has 50 nodes, diffAndApply returns removed=50 and added=0
When stored is empty and newNodes has 20 nodes, diffAndApply returns added=20 and indexed=20
diffAndApply throws KodaError when projectId does not exist

routing.reasoning: New service with cross-store dependencies (Prisma + LanceDB), algorithmic diff logic, and role-based access control enforcement

userStories.title: AST/Symbol Index Pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: AstIndexService.indexCommit() parses source files and stores symbol metadata in the Symbol Prisma table
Symbol.symbolId uses the convention {repoId}:{filePath}::{SymbolName} and is globally unique within a project
getCallers(symbolId) returns all symbols that include this symbol in their JSON callers list
getCallees(symbolId) returns all symbols in this symbol's JSON callees list
When indexCommit is called with files=[{path: 'src/auth.ts', content: '...'}], only src/auth.ts is parsed (incremental — existing symbols for unchanged files are preserved)
Symbol.signature captures parameter types and return type (e.g. '(userId: string): Promise<User>')
Indexing is triggered by a code_commit outbox event (fired by the VCS webhook handler)
A commit with 20 files (avg 200 lines each) is indexed in under 30 seconds
Only actors with role admin or developer can call AstIndexService.indexCommit() directly (not agents); role checked at controller layer
Parser failures for one file are recorded in the result and do not prevent other files in the same commit from being indexed
The code_commit handler resolves changed file contents before calling indexCommit(); the webhook controller only enqueues commit metadata
suggestedCriteria: indexCommit() with zero files returns symbolsIndexed=0 and filesIndexed=0
getSymbol() returns null when symbolId does not exist
getCallers() returns empty array when no symbols call the given symbol
When two symbols have the same name in different files, they have distinct symbolIds

routing.reasoning: New service with parser integration, incremental indexing logic, and Symbol table management with JSON array fields

userStories.title: Ticket/Entity Graph Builder
acceptanceCriteria: EntityGraphService.rebuildGraph(projectId) rebuilds all entity nodes and links for a project
Entity graph data is persisted in EntityNode and EntityLink tables, not only in Phase 2's in-memory EntityStore
onTicketEvent(status_changed) updates the entity node for that ticket (if it exists)
onGraphifyImport() extracts service entities from graphify nodes with type=code_module

The initial implementation does not require a Ticket.serviceId column; service linkage works from current Koda fields (gitRefFile, labels, linked code/module references) until an explicit service relation exists
getRelatedEntities(projectId, entityId, depth=2) returns all entities reachable within 2 hops
getIncidentImpact(projectId, incidentTicketId) returns all entities linked to the incident
Service entities extracted from graphify inherit tags from the graphify node (e.g. ['backend', 'auth'])
Entity graph is updated incrementally via outbox fan-out (no full rebuild on every event)
A graph with 500 nodes and 2000 edges returns getRelatedEntities in under 50ms
suggestedCriteria: When entityId does not exist, getRelatedEntities returns empty array
When incidentTicketId is not an incident type, getIncidentImpact returns empty affectedServices
onGraphifyImport with zero code_module nodes creates no service entities

routing.reasoning: New service with EntityNode/EntityLink persistence, graph traversal algorithms, and event-driven incremental updates

userStories.title: VCS Webhook Handler to code_commit Outbox Event
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Extend VCS webhook controller to handle push events and enqueue code_commit outbox events for AST indexing.

**Motivation** — Code changes from VCS pushes must trigger AST indexing and symbol extraction, but webhook handlers must not synchronously fetch file contents.

**Approach** — VcsWebhookController extends existing project-scoped webhook surface at POST /projects/:slug/vcs-webhook. Webhook validates repository identifier, ref, commits[], and sender. For each commit, enqueue code_commit outbox event with {repoId, commitHash, ref, changedFiles}. AstIndexService.indexCommit() is called by the code_commit outbox handler asynchronously. Webhook handler is idempotent: dedup by commitHash within 5-minute window.

**Security:** GitHub webhook signature verification reuses existing x-hub-signature-256 flow. Webhook secret from project VCS connection record (never hard-coded).
acceptanceCriteria: VcsWebhookController extends existing project-scoped webhook surface at POST /projects/:slug/vcs-webhook to handle push/code-intel events
Webhook payload is validated: presence of repository identifier, ref, commits[], and sender identifier (sender.id, sender.login, or provider equivalent)
For each commit in the push, a code_commit outbox event is enqueued with { repoId, commitHash, ref, changedFiles }
AstIndexService.indexCommit() is called by the code_commit outbox handler, not synchronously by the webhook controller
If event enqueue fails, the webhook logs the failure and returns a non-2xx response so the provider can retry
GitHub webhook signature verification reuses existing x-hub-signature-256 flow; invalid signatures return 401
Webhook secret continues to come from the project's VCS connection record (never hard-coded)
Webhook handler is idempotent: pushing the same commitHash twice does not create duplicate outbox events (dedup by commitHash within a 5-minute window)
suggestedCriteria: When webhook signature is missing, VcsWebhookController returns 401
When commits array is empty, no outbox event is created
When same commitHash is pushed twice within 5 minutes, only one outbox event is created

routing.reasoning: Extends existing webhook controller, new outbox event type, idempotency logic, webhook signature verification

userStories.title: getChangeImpact API
acceptanceCriteria: GET /projects/:slug/codeintel/impact?repoId=X&commitHash=Y&changedFiles=file1,file2 returns a ChangeImpactResult
impactedSymbols contains symbols whose file matches any entry in changedFiles
impactedServices contains service entities linked to impacted symbols through matching Symbol.file → GraphNode.sourceFile or EntityNode.sourceId
impactedTickets contains tickets linked to any impactedServices
impactScore is a number 0-100 computed by the formula above with denominator guards
When called with a ticketId, the result includes provenance source metadata pointing to that ticket
The endpoint returns in under 5 seconds for a commit touching up to 50 files
Only actors with role admin, developer, or agent can call this endpoint (role checked at controller level)
suggestedCriteria: When changedFiles is empty, impactScore is 0 and impactedSymbols/Services/Tickets are empty arrays
When no symbols match changedFiles, impactScore formula term for symbols contributes 0 (not division by zero)
When projectId does not exist, endpoint returns 404

routing.reasoning: API endpoint composing existing services, clear formula, role-based access

userStories.title: CanonicalStateService Snapshot Read Layer
acceptanceCriteria: CanonicalStateService.getSnapshot(query) returns retrievedAt set to the server timestamp
When ticketIds are provided, tickets contains only tickets in the requested projectId
When timeWindow is provided, recentEvents contains only events in the window, ordered by createdAt DESC
activeDecisions is populated from active MemoryItem rows with kind='DECISION'
A non-existent or unauthorized projectId throws the same KodaError/Nathapp exception style used by earlier memory endpoints
The service performs canonical Prisma reads only; it does not query LanceDB, BM25, entity graph, or other derived stores
suggestedCriteria: When ticketIds is empty array, tickets is empty array (not all tickets)
When timeWindow.from and timeWindow.to are both set, recentEvents contains events where createdAt is between from and to
When no active decisions exist, activeDecisions is empty array (not undefined)

routing.reasoning: Composition of existing Prisma reads, no new tables or external store dependencies
